scenarioFile.label: the 2HG team block panel on the first AI team turn (Two-Headed Giant, White + Red vs Yellow + Blue, shared team turns): White's team at 8 life with three untapped Walls of Wood (0/3 defender: they can't attack, so they are still there), Yellow and Blue with two Craw Wurms each (6/4, on the battlefield before their turn). Pass White's turn; the AI team attacks White's team with the Wurms (24 power at 8 life, nothing they fear), and White is asked "Block with Red" with Agree. Type it before the game (Red, Yellow and Blue AI seats). tools/check-scenarios.js, tests/test_bridge_scenario_checks.js
